name: fix_rust_arc_missing_clone
description: Fixes an E0382 move-into-loop error with per-thread Arc clones
prompts: parallel_sum in src/lib.rs does not compile: the Arc is moved into the first spawned closure, so every later loop iteration hits E0382 (use of moved value). Fix src/lib.rs by giving each thread its own handle - clone the Arc per iteration (Arc::clone(&shared)) and move the clone into the closure. The function must compile under cargo test and return the exact sum for any worker count >= 1, including when the data length doesn't divide evenly.
